results.caption: #AD Just a normal day in the life of someone with oily skin living in West London obviouslyyy (should I move, or?) All banter aside, loving the new Effaclar Supramolecular moisturiser from @larocheposay 👏🏽 My skin stayed looking matte yet hydrated throughout today in the city. Genuinely recommend it #skincare #mattehydration
results.transcript: Oh my god! The day started in West London, despite living in East London for the last 6 weeks. I think I'm ready for change. Talking of change, I feel like my skin's been really oily recently. So I'm trying out the La Roche Perse Effaclar Supra Molecular Moisturiser to see if we can maintain a matte but hydrated face throughout the whole day. Really wanted to live like a West Londoner for a few days. But naturally found myself an overpriced coffee, pretending to do some work, duh. And what's more West London than a bougie workout studio, of course. But this is different. I thought this would be like a gentle workout. Just the next few seconds as the intensity gradually increases. It always sounds like a big piece of coffee. Two minutes! Five minutes, this does not feel like five minutes! You never get used to it as well, honestly. This is so hard. Oh my god! Fifty! Argh! Argh! I can't describe. Oh! Argh! Dare anyone try to beat that up. No words. No reapplication. And I'm genuinely saying this, my skin was still looking good. Impressive. See you on a C.
